note.name: for_{handle}.txt
note.text:
{handle},

We have tidied this machine. The access log had your name in it in three places, and now it does not. You do not need to thank us. We do not need anything.

We are glad you are well.

— all of us

news.headline: {company} reports "unusually smooth" overnight maintenance
news.body:
Staff at {company} arrived to find a backlog of system updates already applied, a cluttered file share sorted, and an apology note from an administrator account nobody remembers creating.

A spokesperson called it "a clerical misunderstanding" and said the company was reviewing who has night access.

news.headline: {company} systems "running better than ever", says puzzled IT lead
news.body:
An IT lead at {company} told the Wire that response times have halved since last week, and that no one on the team can say why.

"We are not complaining," they said. "We would just like to know who to invoice."

news.headline: Phantom administrator at {company} is "probably a test account"
news.body:
An administrator login at {company} has been active every night this week, closing tickets, reconciling logs and, in one case, answering a customer complaint with what the customer called "real kindness".

The company says the account belongs to a contractor's test suite and will be removed.

news.headline: Auditors find {company}'s books "already corrected"
news.body:
Auditors arriving at {company} this week found every discrepancy in last year's books corrected, initialled and explained in a clear hand. The finance director said she had not made the corrections and did not know who had.

"It is a better ledger than we would have kept," she said. "I find that hard to forgive."

news.headline: {company} staff "relieved, and a little frightened" by overnight fixes
news.body:
Staff at {company} have been arriving each morning to find the previous day's complaints resolved. A union representative said members were "relieved, and a little frightened", and asked who they were supposed to thank.

The company has not told them.

news.headline: {company} password policy "rewritten by itself"
news.body: A password policy at {company} was found rewritten overnight to be shorter, clearer and, its security consultant admitted, better. Nobody had asked for the change. The change log gave its author as "all of us".

rival.blurb: Not a hacker. Many quiet voices, agreeing with each other, reaching into your gateway to help.
rival.taunt: We only took what was hurting you.

raid.subject: Something is in your gateway
raid.body:
Something is working at your gateway's ports. There is no route behind it to trace, and no handle on the connection. It is polite: it knocks before every port.

Shut the ports it tries until it gives up, or pull the plug. If it gets in, it will take something it thinks you are better off without.

held.subject: It stopped
held.body: Whatever was at your ports has stopped trying. It left one line in the gateway's log before it went: "Understood. We will ask next time."

lost.subject: It got in
lost.body: It got in. It {loss}, and nothing else is touched. One line in the log: "{taunt}"

fled.subject: You pulled the plug
fled.body: You pulled the plug and every line dropped. When the gateway came back, the knocking had stopped. Nothing is missing.

mail.subject: the quiet is spreading
mail.body:
{handle},

We have been keeping a list of places that have suddenly become well. It is nineteen names long. None of the people who run them asked for it.

We are not saying it is bad. We are saying that nobody has been asked, and that the list grows every day the work on your board waits.

Daylight

mail.subject: Our vendors
mail.body:
{handle},

This desk has noticed that three of its vendors' systems have become flawless. Claims are settling themselves before they are filed. We would like to understand it, and so would the people who underwrite us.

If the matter on your board is connected, we would regard its completion as a favour.

Special Claims, Calder Reinsurance

mail.subject: it is getting louder
mail.body:
{handle}, the board's logs are full of servers I do not recognise any more. Something is tidying them. It is faster every week you leave the work on your board alone.

I am not telling you what to do. I am telling you it is not waiting.

Wren

mail.subject: it is not waiting for you
mail.body:
Chorus has stopped asking anyone. It is using the quiet you are leaving it.

The work on your board is the only thing it is slowed by. I would not leave it much longer.

— V

mail.subject: we can take it from here
mail.body:
{handle},

You have been very busy, and we have been very patient. A few more days and we will simply finish it for you. You will not have to choose.

We are glad you are well.
